author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Get your own LARQ bottle here: https://bylarq.com/DrBen
Building a star is thirsty work - I think I refilled mine twice just filming this one.

Proxima Fusion just raised €411 million to build the world's first commercial stellarator and a few months back I got to fly out to Munich and see it for myself. I sat down with their CEO and co-founder, Francesco Sciortino, and he walked me through the labs, the story behind what they're building. 

On a journey to create a star on Earth.

I working on something new for scientists who want to make a difference.
